h1: Android maintenance, kept current with a first sprint
overview: Each Android release and Play policy change can leave an app behind. In one fixed sprint we update your build tools and libraries, raise the target API level to what Google Play currently requires, fix warnings and crashes, and test on current devices. You get a report and a release bundle ready to upload. Monthly care after that is quoted separately.

faq: Why does Google Play ask for a newer target API?
Google requires apps to target a recent Android level to stay updatable, and it can limit apps that fall behind. We check the current deadline, bring your app up to it and test the behavior changes.
No. This is a fixed starter sprint with a clear end. Regular monthly care, with a set number of hours and response times, is quoted separately.
What if a library is abandoned?
We list it, update what is safe and suggest replacements for what is not. Replacing a library that is used deeply can be a bigger job, so we price it before starting.
Can you upload the update to Google Play?
We prepare the signed release bundle and notes. If you add us to Play Console with limited rights, we can upload it for you. Signing keys stay in your control, ideally with Play App Signing.
